This application coming on for admission this day, the c
 following:
 Order
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.174/2023, dated 22.03.2023, registered at Police Station Kuthla District Katni for commission of offence under Sections 420,34 of the IPC and Section 6(1) of Madhya Pradesh Nikshepakon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniam, 2000 and section 21(1) and 21(2) of Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019.
He is in detention since 23.2.2023.
opennyai_summary.decision:
As prayed by counsel for the applicant, this first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C filed on behalf of applicant - Omkar Singh is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
However, applicant shall be at liberty to move the application for bail before the trial court.
